Tecla IO | Digital Sales Specialist | REMOTE (Worldwide) | Paid, $10 -$13 per hour

We are searching for a high-energy communicator to join our team as a Digital Sales & Communications Specialist. If you love building rapport, solving problems, and turning casual chats into meaningful business wins, this opportunity is built for you.

Key Responsibilities & Focus Direct Outreach: Initiate contact with prospective clients using phone lines, digital messaging, and email networks. Advisory & Solutions: Listen closely to customer inquiries and present our offerings clearly and effectively. Record Management: Log notes, track lead stages, and update pipeline info cleanly using our CRM. Team Innovation: Share feedback and brainstorm strategies during our regular team meetings. Compensation & Rewards Hourly Pay Rate: $10.35 – $13.95 / hour

To apply: lily.stewart.recruiting@outlook.com

Subject: Digital Sales & Communications Specialist
